description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 twofeat: the features of the sequences of a file (any input format of seqret that carries features) are tested against the criteria of feature A (aSource, aType, aSense 0 / + / -, aMinScore, aMaxScore, aTag, aValue) and of feature B (bSource ... bValue); wildcards * and ?, several patterns separated by blanks, commas, semicolons or bars; the scores are cut to integers) and every pair of an A and a B feature in the required relation is reported: overlap (A any, O overlap, NO none, NW overlap but not within, AW A within B, BW B within A), distance between minRange and maxRange (ignored unless min is less than max; measured from the nearest, left, right or furthest ends: rangeType N / L / R / F), sense (A any, S same, O opposite: the opposite sense stops the program with a fatal error of the library), as a new feature (type typeOut, source twofeat, covering both, tags startA endA startB endB) or, with twoOut, as the two features. The report is in reportFormat (table default; the names of featreport or the report qualifiers as typed). Equals the installed program on 1 000 runs (every input format with features, every option, every report format). A5-8c3h, B09 F263.

sequence.description: The text of the sequence file with features (any input format of seqret), or a sequence as letters (no features).

sequenceFormat.description: The input format (-sformat); default: the program finds the format.

aSense.description: Sense of feature A (-asense): 0 any, + forward ('-' is read as any by the program).

aValue.description: Value of the tags of feature A (-avalue); default *.

bValue.description: Value of the tags of feature B (-bvalue); default *.

overlap.description: Overlap (-overlap): A any, O overlap, NO none, NW overlap but not within, AW A within B, BW B within A.

rangeType.description: Where the distance is measured (-rangetype): N nearest ends, L left ends, R right ends, F furthest ends.

sense.description: Sense of the pair (-sense): A any, S same, O opposite (fatal in the program).

order.description: Order of the features (-order): accepted, not used by the program.

twoOut.description: Report the two features of a pair instead of one feature that covers them (-twoout).

typeOut.description: The type of the new feature (-typeout); default misc_feature.

reportFormat.description: The report format name or the report qualifiers as typed (see featreport); default table.

qualifiers.description: Sequence input qualifiers as typed after the sequence on the command line: -sbegin1 -send1 -sreverse1, -slower1 -supper1 -snucleotide1 -sprotein1 -scircular1, -sformat1 F, -sid1 name, -sdbname1 db, -squick1, -iquery1 query, -ioffset1 bytes.

files.description: More files by name (file name -> text) that sequenceValue may name.

sequenceValue.description: The USA of the sequence input (-sequence): [format::]file[begin:end:r], file:id, file:field:value, file{a|b}, @list, list::list, asis::TEXT, db:id; the text of sequence is the file 'sequence.dat'.

definitions.description: The text of an EMBOSS configuration file (.embossrc) that defines databases for sequenceValue.

report.description: The text of the report file.

messages.description: What the library printed (warnings and errors).

errors.message: Unable to read sequence ... (no sequence in the file)
An input on which the reference program never stops or dies by a fault, and the opposite sense on opposite strands (a fatal error of the library), are refused
